# Story 02 — REPORTS-1-WEB admin — I see the queue by status (Story: CRM-125)

## Prerequisites

- `REPORTS-1-API (CRM-124)` complet
ed: the GET endpoint that returns the per-status counts must exist and be admin-guarded. This screen only reads it; do not der

ive counts on the client.
- Coordinate with the owner of `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` before ad

ding new leaves — `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` fails a key present in one file but not the other.
- Read `.squad/plan-lessons.md` end-to-end before

starting; **L-63** (do not fetch before you know who is asking) is the defect this story is most likely to repeat.

---

## Story

Goal

An admin who opens the queue-by-status report sees every status the API returned, in the reader's language, with numbers formatted for
their locale. Loading, empty and error are designed states, not accidents. A non-admin who types the URL sees the same explanation the other admin screens give and

the navigation never offered the link.

**Not in scope:** any API change, a date-range
picker (arrives with `REPORTS-4-WEB (CRM-131)`), a chart library, and the other three reports screens (`CRM-127`

, `CRM-129`, `CRM-131`).

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogPage.tsx` — the shape to copy. Read the whole file (≈ 8

KB): how it composes the admin gate, loading skeleton, empty state, error state and the table body.
2. `web/src/pages/audit/useAuditLog.ts` — the s
ibling hook (≈ 3 KB). Copy its pattern for calling the API through `useRequest` and for **not firing the request when the current sub

ject is not permitted**. This is the L-63 guard.
3. `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogPage.css` — the per-page CSS pattern. All colours resolve through the t

okens in `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` (D-1). No hex or rgb literal in this new `.css`.
4. `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogP
age.test.tsx` — the test scaffold to mirror: admin-only, loading, empty, error, i18n language switch, and the "no raw status

" assertion.
5. `web/src/app/routes.tsx` — the existing admin routes to imitate:
   - Line 148 `path="/ticket-categories"` and

the surrounding `<Route>` (guarded admin route).
   - Line 162 `path="/accounts"`.
   - Line 176 `path="/audit"`

. Add the new route in the same block, in the same style.
6. `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx` — line 115 shows the `<Link to="/aud
it">` navigation entry, gated by the same admin check the shell already applies. Add the report link the same way (

or under whatever admin-nav grouping the shell already uses); do not invent a new gate.
7. `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `
web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — `t` is a plain object **one level deep** with camelCase leaves. Add a new top-level key (e.g. `reportsQueueByStatus`) with the same set

of leaves in both files. Do not import a `useT()` and do not introduce interpolation.
8. `web/src/shared/i18n/format.ts`
— line 12 explains why Arabic uses `ar-EG` and forbids simplifying it. Numbers on this page go through `useFormatters().formatNumber`

from `web/src/shared/i18n/useFormatters.ts`, never `String(n)`.
9. `web/src/pages/tickets/history-sentence.ts` and `web/src/pages/tickets/pager-sentence.ts` — the
shape to copy when a label needs a slot. There is no interpolation function; a sentence with a slot is assembled the way these two build one

.
10. `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — will scan the new page. Every user-visible string must resolve through `t`.
11. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` and

`web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — the request primitives used by every other page hook. Match their signatures.
12. `web/src/shared/session/use-me.ts` — the source
of the current subject and role. The hook that fetches the report must **only** trigger once `me` has resolved **and** the role q

ualifies as admin. See how `useAuditLog.ts` handles the same gate.

Grep to run before writing:

- `grep -n "is

Admin\|role ===" web/src/app/` — copy whichever admin predicate is already the convention.
- `grep -n "formatNumber" web/src

/pages/` — see existing usages before you introduce a new one.
- `grep -n "reports" web/src/shared/api/` — confirm the API client already

exposes the endpoint from CRM-124 (or add the client method there, matching the surrounding style).

---

## Product r

ules (from story)

- Every status the API returns is shown, **including zeros**. Do not filter client-side.
- Status names are read from the i18n res

ource; never render a raw key such as `pending` (**BR-6**).
- Loading, empty and error are explicit designed states (**D-2**), mat

ching the rest of the desk.
- Non-admins never see the screen and never see the link.
- Arabic mirrors English

; no number is reversed by the direction (numbers go through `formatNumber`).

---

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Create the page and h

ook

Create file: `web/src/pages/reports/QueueByStatusPage.tsx`

- Function component, no default export (match the named-

export style used by `AuditLogPage.tsx`).
- Render the admin refusal explanation when `me` has resolved and the subject is not admin — copy the exact refusal block

from `AuditLogPage.tsx`, wording pulled from `t`.
- While `me` is still loading, render the same skeleton `AuditLogPage.tsx` uses (`

web/src/shared/ui/Skeleton.tsx`).
- Once admin is confirmed, call `useQueueByStatus()` (below) and render:
  - **loading** → `Skeleton`
  - **error

** → `web/src/shared/ui/ErrorState.tsx`
  - **empty** (API returned no rows) → `web/src/shared/ui/EmptyState.tsx`
  - **data** → a `<Stack>` (
`web/src/shared/ui/Stack.tsx`) of rows, each row `<status label> — <formatted count>`. Use `Text

`/`Heading` primitives from `web/src/shared/ui/`. The status label comes from `t.reportsQueueByStatus.status[<key>]`; the count comes from `useFormatters().formatNumber(row.count)`.
-

Include zeros: iterate over what the API returned; do not filter.
- No literal colour in JSX; class names only, res

olved through the css file.

Create file: `web/src/pages/reports/QueueByStatusPage.css`

- Layout only. All colour, sp

acing, radius, font tokens through `var(--…)` from `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css`. No hex/rgb.
- No mir

rored-styles pitfalls — see the checks enforced by `web/src/shared/i18n/no-mirrored-styles.test.ts`.

Create file: `web/src

/pages/reports/useQueueByStatus.ts`

- Signature: `export function useQueueByStatus(): { state, data, error, reload }` — match the return-

shape of `useAuditLog.ts` field-for-field.
- Read `me` from `use-me.ts`. **Do not fire the request** until `me.status === 'ready'` **
and** `me.role` is admin. This is **L-63**; a naive `useEffect` that fires on mount will put ref

usals in the audit log for people who did nothing wrong.
- Use `useRequest` from `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` to call the CRM-124 endpoint through
the existing `client.ts` API. Do not construct URLs inline; add a `getQueueByStatus()` method next

to the other report clients if one is not already there.
- Do not derive or sort counts on

the client beyond what the API already returned — the API is the source of truth.

### 2 — Route and navigation

File: `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

- Add the import next to line 18

(`AuditLogPage`):
  ```ts
  import { QueueByStatusPage } from '../pages/reports/QueueByStatusPage';
  ```
- Add a new `<Route>` immediately after the `/audit` block (line
176) using the **same admin-guard wrapper** already applied to `/audit` and `/ticket-categories`. Do **not** invent a third

guard.
  - Suggested path: `/reports/queue-by-status`.
  - `element={<QueueByStatusPage />}`.
- The catch-all `<Route path

="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />` at line 198 must remain last.

File: `web/src/app/desk-shell/DeskShell.tsx`

- Around line 115, next to the `<Link to="/audit">` ent
ry that reads `t.shell.navAudit`, add a sibling `<Link to="/reports/queue-by-status">` under whatever admin-only grouping already wraps `/audit`. Use `

t.shell.navReportsQueueByStatus`. Do **not** show the link for non-admins.

### 3 — i18n

File: `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts`

- Add a top-level object

`reportsQueueByStatus` with camelCase leaves, one level deep. Include at minimum:
  - `title`
  - `loading`, `empty`, `error`, `ret

ry`
  - `adminOnly` (the refusal wording — copy the exact string the `/audit` page uses if that page

already localises it; otherwise phrase it identically)
  - `columnStatus`, `columnCount`
  - `status.open`, `status.pending`, `status.resolved`, `status.clos

ed`, and any other status the API returns for `REPORTS-1-API`. Confirm the full set with CRM-124's response contract before adding.
- Add `sh

ell.navReportsQueueByStatus`.

File: `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

- Mirror **every** new leaf with an Arabic translation. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.

ts` fails the build if a key exists in one file and not the other.

If any label needs a slot (e.g. "Total: N"), assemble it the way `web/src/pages/tickets/history-sentence.

ts` and `pager-sentence.ts` do — do not import an interpolation library and do not add a `useT()` helper.

### 4 — Formatting

- Every count is rendered through `useFormatters().formatNumber(

row.count)`. Never `String(row.count)`, never `row.count.toLocaleString()` inline. `web/src/shared/i18n/format.ts:12` is deliberate about `ar-EG`; do not simplify.

---

## Backend Tasks

No backend changes required. The endpoint is delivered by `REPORTS-1-API (CRM-124)`.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Subject un
resolved on mount.** The hook must not call the report endpoint until `me` is `ready` (L-63). Enforced in `useQueueByStatus.ts`; ver

ified by a vitest that asserts no `fetch` fires while `me` is loading.
- **Non-admin arrives at the URL directly.** `QueueByStatusPage.tsx` renders the admin refusal block

(same wording as `/audit`) and the hook never fires. The nav link in `DeskShell.tsx` is not shown for non-admins.
- **API returns a status with `count === 0`.** Row must

still render (the intake calls this out explicitly). No `if (row.count) …` filter anywhere in the component.
- **API returns a status key the i18n file does
not know.** Fall back to the raw key surrounded by warning styling **only in dev**, but in production still render the ra
w key to satisfy the "every status shown" rule. Log a warning so it is noticed. Update `en.ts`/`ar.ts` in the same PR when

a new key appears.
- **API failure (5xx / network).** `ErrorState` renders with a retry that calls the hook's `reload`. No

console-only failure.
- **Empty response body (API returns `[]`).** `EmptyState` renders with a design

ed message (`t.reportsQueueByStatus.empty`).
- **Arabic direction.** Layout mirrors via existing `dir` hand
ling in the shell; numbers stay LTR-safe because `formatNumber` produces the correct locale digits (`ar-EG`). Do not add `dire

ction:` overrides in the new `.css`.
- **`tsc -b` vs vitest drift.** `cd web && npm run build` must

pass; a default-in-destructuring that references a sibling passes vitest and fails `tsc`. Run `npm run build`, not just `npm test`.
- **Hardcoded strings.** `web/src/pages/

no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` will scan this page; every user-visible literal must resolve through `t`.

---

## Test Plan

1. Create `web/src/pages/re

ports/QueueByStatusPage.test.tsx`, mirroring `web/src/pages/audit/AuditLogPage.test.tsx`. Tests:
   1. Renders the admin-only refusal when the current subject is not admin,
and **no request is fired** (assert via the stub in `web/src/testing/stub-me.ts` and the request

stub).
   2. Renders the loading skeleton while the request is in flight.
   3. Renders every row the API returned, **including a status wh

ose count is 0**.
   4. Renders `EmptyState` when the API returns an empty list.
   5. Renders `ErrorState` when the API rejects and reload retriggers the fetch.
   6.
Status labels render from `t`, never as `pending` / raw key — assert the rendered text against the English resource and again after swit

ching to Arabic (`web/src/shared/i18n/language-switch.test.tsx` shows the switching pattern).
   7. Numbers render via `formatNumber` — assert the

Arabic-locale-formatted string for a two- or three-digit count in the `ar-EG` case.
2. Extend `web/src/app/routing.test.ts
x` (already covers admin-only routes) with a case that hitting `/reports/queue-by-status` as a non-admin produces the

refusal, and as an admin produces the report page.
3. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` will fail automatically if the two locale files drift; no new

file needed, but the two must be updated together.
4. `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` will pick up the new page automatically; run it and fix any hit

.
5. `web/src/shared/i18n/no-mirrored-styles.test.ts` — run to confirm the new `.css` does not add direction-flipping styles.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:**
   ```sh
   cd web
   npm test
   npm run build
   ```
   `npm test` is vitest; `npm run build` is `tsc -b && v

ite build`. **Both** must pass. Do not rely on `npm test` alone — the web suite does not typecheck.
2. **Manual smoke:** `cd web && npm run dev
`, sign in as an admin, open `/reports/queue-by-status`, verify every returned status appears (including zeros), the numbers are formatted, and switching language to Arabic mirrors the layout.
3. **Non-admin smoke:** sign in as a non-admin, confirm the navigation link is absent and typing `/reports/queue-by-status` shows the refusal — check

the audit log for the same session shows **no** refused-request entry (L-63).
4. **Regression:**
   ```sh
   cd web && npm test
   cd api && npm test

```
   `cd api && npm test` catches any accidental API dependency; it should stay green with zero touched

files under `api/`.
5. **AI-attribution grep:** run `git grep -nEi "openai|copilot|chatgpt|claude|assistant|gener

ated by ai"` on the diff — nothing committed may mention AI assistance, including in ignore files.

---

## Done

Criteria

- [ ] A new route `/reports/queue-by-status` renders the report for admins, using the same guard as `/audit` and `/ticket-categories`; non-admins see

the refusal and never see the link.
- [ ] Every status returned by CRM-124 is displayed, **including zeros**; nothing is filtered client-side.
- [ ] Status names are read from `t.reportsQueue

ByStatus.status.*` in both `en.ts` and `ar.ts`; no raw key (e.g. `pending`) reaches the DOM.
- [ ] Counts render through `useFormatters().formatN

umber`; `ar-EG` digits appear in Arabic.
- [ ] Loading, empty and error states use the shared `Skeleton` / `EmptyState` / `ErrorState` primitives; no

ad-hoc replacements.
- [ ] The hook does **not** fire the request until `me` is ready and admin (L-63); a vitest proves it.
- [ ] `

web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`, `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts`, and `web/src/shared/i18n/no-mirrored-styles.test.ts` all pass.
- [ ] `cd web && npm test` **

and** `cd web && npm run build` both pass; `cd api && npm test` still passes with no `api/` files changed.
- [ ] Nothing committed mentions AI assistance (grep clean).

**STOP H
ERE. Report to the user and wait for confirmation before proceeding to the next reports story.**
